question: Should CodexBar officially support a default-off `claudeSwapShowSingleAccount` preference that lets one claude-swap row replace ambient Claude presentation?
rationale: The merged claude-swap design established precedence for multiple accounts; accepting a one-account source override is a new user-facing policy rather than a mechanically implied bug fix.

options.title: Sponsor the opt-in boundary
options.body: Keep the default off and accept the setting after redacted real one-account proof confirms the intended source selection and explicit override behavior.

options.title: Retain the two-account contract
options.body: Keep current behavior and decline the new one-account preference if a single adapter row should never supersede ambient Claude presentation.

recommendation.title: Sponsor the opt-in boundary
recommendation.body: Keep the default off and accept the setting after redacted real one-account proof confirms the intended source selection and explicit override behavior.

likelyOwner.reason: Repository-level acceptance is needed for a new persistent provider preference and source-precedence contract.
